allowances.source: Directly fetched, confirmed 2026 change: actiz.nl 'CAO VVT, hoofdstuk 4.4 Onregelmatig werken en de vergoeding die je daarvoor ontvangt' states the onregelmatigheidstoeslag (ORT) rose per 1 January 2026 — weekdag-nacht 00:00-06:00/22:00-24:00 from 44% to 47%, zaterdag 00:00-06:00/22:00-24:00 from 49% to 52%. Kept placeholder despite this confirmed citation because the full day/time/holiday/regeling-A-vs-B stacking matrix was not transcribed in this pass (design.md Named gap 2) — a real, cited fact is not the same as a complete, verifiable leaf. The windows carry the 2026 rate as pct and the earlier one as pctFrom; the leaf stays a placeholder, so the run pays them only through a contract override with a reason (payroll-cao-components).
